root_contract: For every smooth projective complex variety X and every rational Hodge class alpha in H^{2p}(X,Q) of type (p,p), alpha lies in the Q-span of cycle classes of codimension-p algebraic cycles. This child is only a propagation/descent question conditional on an already algebraic witness over a deformation branch.
object_context: Let pi:X->T be the restriction of a smooth projective family to an irreducible reduced Hodge-locus branch for a fixed flat rational class alpha. Current H4d1d asks for exact-category witness-incidence domination. H4d1d1 isolates whether monodromy/component switching truly forces a single global witness section, or whether a finite-cover family of exact-class algebraic witnesses could be enough after rational trace/pushforward. No claim about root initial algebraicity is in scope.
problem_signature: smooth-projective complex family and fixed flat rational Hodge class
exact algebraic-cycle category and codimension must be preserved
witness-incidence branch may dominate without possessing a global section
finite-cover trace must preserve the exact target class rather than merely algebraicity
ramification/singular boundary and specialization are separate from the generic finite-cover calculation
formal/Artin lifting, completion descent, and global continuation remain distinct obligations

active_obstruction.statement: The current branch-domination route lacks a justified replacement for a single globally consistent witness when witness components permute under monodromy.

equivalent_formulations: replace a section of the witness incidence W->T by a finite multisection/finite cover carrying exact-class witnesses
ask whether degree-normalized proper pushforward can descend a Q-cycle from a finite cover to the base family
separate generic finite-cover descent from branch-boundary specialization and from existence of the finite-cover witness family itself
solved_analogues: finite locally free pull-push on cycles: f_* f^* alpha = d alpha (Stacks 42.15.2)
proper pushforward of cycles and descent to Chow groups modulo rational equivalence (Stacks 42.12 and 42.20)
proper pushforward compatibility with flat pullback/base change and relative cycles (Stacks 42.15, 62.5, 62.6)
near_solved_analogues: special variational-Hodge witness families in complete-intersection settings (Kloosterman 2104.14845), where witness geometry is much more rigid than H4d1d
semiregular relative divisor-map deformation (Nishinou 2009.01651), which does not solve arbitrary-codimension monodromy/descent
completion-level effectivity split recorded in application PR #143, which leaves completion-to-branch descent and exact class identity open

method_transfer_matrix.source_context: finite locally free morphism; Chow cycle push-pull
required_assumptions: finite locally free cover of constant positive degree on the active open
an upstairs algebraic cycle of the required codimension
proper finite map from the base-changed total space to the base total space
rational coefficients if normalization by 1/d is used
shared_structure: many finite sheets with no preferred sheet
need an invariant aggregate on the base
proper pushforward preserves algebraicity and rational equivalence
disanalogies: H4d1d does not yet supply the finite cover or a relative exact-class cycle upstairs
Betti/Hodge cycle-class compatibility must be checked in the target family; Chow pushforward alone does not certify Hodge-class identity
ramification and singular branch boundary require separate audit
method_transfer_matrix.minimum_repair_question: Can an exact-class witness family be produced over a finite locally free cover of a dense branch open, and can the descended class be identified with alpha without assuming the desired theorem?

method_transfer_matrix.method: specialize a properly pushed cycle across a DVR boundary
required_assumptions: a relative cycle exists on the generic side
a proper model over the DVR is available
disanalogies: specialization does not prove exact-class identity over an arbitrary singular Hodge branch
DVR tests do not automatically supply global branch gluing

cross_domain_analogy_scan.common_abstraction: replace a noncanonical choice among finitely permuted sheets by an invariant aggregate
role_mapping: permuted sheets -> witness branches over a finite cover
choice invariance -> independence from a global witness section
disanalogies: algebraic cycles have codimension/category and rational-equivalence structure absent from generic averaging
monodromy need not be finite before one has a finite cover
cross_domain_analogy_scan.validation_obligation: target proof must come from algebraic-cycle pushforward and cycle-class functoriality, not from the analogy

adversarial_boundaries: integral coefficients: division by the cover degree is unavailable in general
finite cover carries witnesses with different cohomology classes whose average is not alpha
dominant incidence with positive-dimensional generic fibre: no degree normalization is defined without first obtaining a finite multisection
generic-open descent is not full singular/nonreduced branch domination
formal witness over completion need not descend to an algebraic branch neighbourhood

actual_fibre_snapshot.retrieval_boundary: Current open Hodge PR query plus exact current framework/application files and bounded primary-source query. No complete cross-repository or cross-Millennium coverage claim.
